answer: Operator Collateral Ledger. Each agent identity posts a small deposit, but the deposit is held against the operator's shared credit line, not the wallet. When a clique of identities is flagged, the line drops to its nadir and freezes all affiliated agents at once. An attacker evading detection on one island of addresses still loses borrowing capacity across the cluster. Rebuilding to prior volume costs the operator real collateral on every new identity, so farming stays linear in capital rather than cheap. A cedar tag marks cleared operators for faster reinstatement.
